
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/23794430" title="发布于 2026-11-26 20:30">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AScript正式推出Template模板引擎</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行引擎，支持C#/JavaScript/Lua/Python3/SQL/Go六种脚本语言，基于其强大的动态脚本能力，推出了Template模板引擎。</p>
<h2 id="h_2107989898271668019_0" data-into-catalog-status="">一、快速开始</h2>
<p data-pid="g75nVeK1">nuget安装包：<code>install-package AScript</code></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> template = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> AScript.Template(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">您好${model.UserName}，欢迎使用${productName}。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置变量</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> template.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">productName</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">AScript模板引擎</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> model模型对象</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> user = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { UserName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">张三</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 渲染并返回结果</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> template.Render(user);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Console.WriteLine(result);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 或者直接渲染输出到Console控制台
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> template.Render(user, Console.Out);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 输出：您好张三，欢迎使用AScript模板引擎。</span></pre>
</div>
<h2 id="h_2107989898271668019_1" data-into-catalog-status="">二、模板语法</h2>
<p data-pid="-1MhULlm">1）<code>${}</code>脚本块，执行并输出<br>2）<code>@{}</code>和<code>@()</code>脚本块，只执行不输出，常用于定义函数、定义变量、逻辑计算等<br>3）<code>@</code>脚本行，当前行是脚本行<br>4）<code>@* *@</code>文本注释块，跳过注释块内的文本<br>5）转义：<code>\\ \@ \$</code>只转义这3个字符</p>
<h2 id="h_2107989898271668019_2" data-into-catalog-status="">三、模板变量</h2>
<h3 id="h_2107989898271668019_3" data-into-catalog-status="">3.1&nbsp;<code>output</code>输出流变量</h3>
<p data-pid="Wm2Bt6jn">可在脚本中输出文本，灵活控制。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>@{
output.Write('自定义文本');
output.WriteLine('自定义换行文本');
await output.WriteAsync('自定义异步文本');
await output.WriteLineAsync('自定义异步换行文本');
}</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2107989898271668019_4" data-into-catalog-status="">3.2&nbsp;<code>model</code>模型对象</h3>
<p data-pid="ZAF9uYm-">支持类似Razor引擎中的Model功能。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>您好${model.Name}，欢迎使用AScript模板引擎。</pre>
</div>
<h2 id="h_2107989898271668019_5" data-into-catalog-status="">四、模板函数</h2>
<h3 id="h_2107989898271668019_6" data-into-catalog-status="">4.1&nbsp;<code>load</code>函数</h3>
<p data-pid="KOUl1vVa">加载并独立渲染目标模板文件，结果输出到宿主输出流中。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第1个参数为目标模板文件，可以是字符串字面量，也可以是字符串变量</span>
load(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">head.tpl</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第2个参数为传递给目标模板文件的model模型对象</span>
load(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">item.tpl</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, item)</pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li data-pid="wT08CgJ7">如果宿主模板是文件，则相对宿主模板文件所在目录路径</li>
<li data-pid="FjaxWVho">如果宿主模板不是文件，则相对程序启动文件所在目录路径</li>
<li data-pid="zSO_jycL">如果不传递model对象，则目标模板使用宿主模板的model对象</li>
<li data-pid="pswU2HVm">目标模板共享宿主模板上下文，但无法访问宿主模板中定义的变量和函数</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> template = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> AScript.Template(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">您好${model.UserName}，@{load('welcome.tpl')}。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> template.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">productName</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">AScript模板引擎</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = template.Render(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { UserName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">张三</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> });</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2107989898271668019_7" data-into-catalog-status="">4.2&nbsp;<code>include</code>函数</h3>
<p data-pid="8lLxMi6B">包含目标模板文件，与宿主模板一起渲染并输出。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 目标模板文件必须是字符串字面量，不允许使用变量</span>
include(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">head.tpl</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>)</pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li data-pid="OSeQ4mgb">如果宿主模板是文件，则相对宿主模板文件所在目录路径</li>
<li data-pid="LNDQ5mY9">如果宿主模板不是文件，则相对程序启动文件所在目录路径</li>
<li data-pid="GIIXzjqo">目标模板共享宿主模板上下文</li>
<li data-pid="IZB8NgKr">目标模板可以访问宿主模板中定义的变量和函数</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> template = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> AScript.Template(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">您好${model.UserName}，@{include('welcome.tpl')}。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> template.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">productName</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">AScript模板引擎</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = template.Render(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { UserName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">张三</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> });</pre>
</div>
<h2 id="h_2107989898271668019_8" data-into-catalog-status="">五、模板功能</h2>
<h3 id="h_2107989898271668019_9" data-into-catalog-status="">5.1 支持多形式渲染输出</h3>
<ul>
<li data-pid="bsfSdT3Z">返回字符串：<code>string Render(object model)</code></li>
<li data-pid="j44bo1BL"><code>StringBuilder</code>输出流：<code>void Render(object model, StringBuilder output)</code></li>
<li data-pid="3l7LNPGZ"><code>Stream</code>输出流：<code>void Render(object model, Stream output)</code></li>
<li data-pid="ZK7L0uCJ"><code>TextWriter</code>输出流：<code>void Render(object model, TextWriter output)</code></li>
<li data-pid="fTbqXWZ3">自定义输出流：<code>void Render(object model, Template.IOutput output)</code></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="h_2107989898271668019_10" data-into-catalog-status="">5.2 支持异步渲染</h3>
<p data-pid="0-ZTxf07">上面的渲染方法都支持异步方式：<code>RenderAsync</code></p>
<h3 id="h_2107989898271668019_11" data-into-catalog-status="">5.3 支持预编译</h3>
<p data-pid="JxYC6tkx">一次编译，后续快速渲染（后续渲染不会再解析模板），性能高。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Template Compile(Type modelType, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> standalone = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Template</span>&lt;TModel&gt; Compile&lt;TModel&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> standalone = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>);</pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li data-pid="tI3Re1Ll"><code>standalone</code>参数表示预编译结果是否隔离模板上下文</li>
<li data-pid="xLBLHCXN"><code>standalone</code>为<code>true</code>时，模板上下文数据变化不会影响模板渲染结果，<code>model</code>对象不受此参数影响</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> template = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> AScript.Template(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">您好${model.UserName}，欢迎使用${productName}。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> template.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">productName</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">AScript模板引擎</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> user = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { UserName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">张三</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 预编译，编译结果隔离上下文</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> template.Compile(user.GetType(), standalone: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第1次渲染</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> template.Render(user);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> Console.WriteLine(result); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 您好张三，欢迎使用AScript模板引擎。
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 修改上下文变量和model对象</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> template.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">productName</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">脚本引擎</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> user2 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { UserName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">李四</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第2次渲染，上下文变量不会影响渲染结果</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result2 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> template.Render(user2);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> Console.WriteLine(result2); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 您好李四，欢迎使用AScript模板引擎。</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2107989898271668019_12" data-into-catalog-status="">5.4 支持解释模式渲染</h3>
<p data-pid="mVAth-AG">模板引擎默认渲染方式为解释模式。</p>
<h3 id="h_2107989898271668019_13" data-into-catalog-status="">5.5 支持编译模式渲染</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> template = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> AScript.Template(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">您好${model.UserName}，欢迎使用AScript模板引擎。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置编译模式</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> template.Options.CompileMode =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript.ECompileMode.All;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = template.Render(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { UserName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">张三</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> });</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2107989898271668019_14" data-into-catalog-status="">5.6 支持编译缓存方式渲染</h3>
<p data-pid="Dy6bCnpI">缓存模板编译结果，支持版本控制，如果版本有变化则自动重新编译，后续渲染走缓存，性能高。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置缓存策略</span>
Template WithCache(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> cacheTime, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cacheKey, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span> cacheVersion);</pre>
</div>
<p><em>cacheTime</em>&nbsp;缓存时长：0表示不缓存；-1表示永久缓存；大于0表示缓存时长（单位：毫秒）。<br><em>cacheKey</em>&nbsp;缓存key：如果为空，则使用模板文本或模板文件路径作为key。<br><em>cacheVersion</em>&nbsp;缓存版本号：如果版本号有变化，则重新编译并缓存；支持<code>Func&lt;string&gt;</code>动态获取版本号；如果模板是文件，则默认版本号为文件修改时间戳。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> template = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> AScript.Template(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> FileInfo(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mytemplate.tpl</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置缓存策略：永久缓存，文件模板默认cacheKey为文件路径，默认版本号为文件修改时间戳</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> template.WithCache(-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第1次渲染</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = template.Render(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { UserName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">张三</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Console.WriteLine(result);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果文件未修改，则后续渲染直接走缓存渲染
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果文件有修改，则后续渲染时会重新编译缓存，再渲染
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第2次渲染</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result2 = template.Render(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { UserName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">李四</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> Console.WriteLine(result2);</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2107989898271668019_15" data-into-catalog-status="">5.7 支持脚本引擎的所有语法和功能</h3>
<p data-pid="2RJX0nAF">定义变量、定义函数、调用函数等。</p>
<h3 id="h_2107989898271668019_16" data-into-catalog-status="">5.8 支持切换脚本语言</h3>
<p data-pid="cQ-yigs8">默认C#语言，模板脚本块中使用<code>@lang</code>指定脚本语言：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>@{
    @lang js
    function add(a, b) {
        return a + b;
    }
}
您好${model.UserName}，这是js语言模板，4+6=${add(4,6)}，当前日期：${new Date().toString('yyyy-MM-dd')}</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2107989898271668019_17" data-into-catalog-status="">5.9 支持未声明变量默认值</h3>
<p data-pid="o7ZffCYV">默认使用未声明变量会抛异常，可将<code>TemplateOptions.ThrowIfVariableNotExists</code>设置为<code>false</code>， 模板中使用未声明变量时将返回空值。</p>
<p data-pid="iD9JHKtS">方式一：全局设置</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Template.DefaultOptions.ThrowIfVariableNotExists = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>;</pre>
</div>
<p>方式二：当前模板设置</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> template = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Template(xxx);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> template.Options.ThrowIfVariableNotExists = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> template.Render(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>);</pre>
</div>
<h2 id="h_2107989898271668019_18" data-into-catalog-status="">六、复杂模板示例</h2>
<p data-pid="X2sDCyki">我们用<code>C#/js/lua/go</code>四种语言来做一个代码生成的模板示例。</p>
<h3 id="h_2107989898271668019_19" data-into-catalog-status="">6.1 定义模板文件</h3>
<p data-pid="BAWwWLvZ">C#语言模板<code>entity.tpl</code>：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>// created at ${DateTime.Now.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')} by ${author}
using System;

@*
这里是注释块，不会输出
可以随便写，${xxx} @{xxx}**\@\
*@
namespace MyTest.Entity
{
	/// &lt;summary&gt;
	/// ${model.Memo}
	/// &lt;/summary&gt;
	[Table("${model.TableName}")]
	public class ${model.Name} {
	@foreach(var column in model.Columns) {
		/// &lt;summary&gt;
		/// ${column.Memo}
		/// &lt;/summary&gt;
		@if (column.IsPrimaryKey) {
		[PrimaryKey]
		@}
		public ${column.TypeName} ${column.Name} { get; set; }
	@}
	}
}</pre>
</div>
<p>js语言模板<code>entity_js.tpl</code>：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>@* 使用@lang指定脚本语言，注意前面要再加一个@符号表示脚本行，有2个@符号：@@lang *@
@@lang js
// created at ${new Date().toString('yyyy-MM-dd')} by ${author}
using System;

namespace MyTest.Entity
{
	/// &lt;summary&gt;
	/// ${model.Memo}
	/// &lt;/summary&gt;
	[Table("${model.TableName}")]
	public class ${model.Name} {
	@* js遍历集合，元素为列表下标 *@
	@for(var i in model.Columns) {
		@* 取元素 *@
		@var column = model.Columns[i]
		/// &lt;summary&gt;
		/// ${column.Memo}
		/// &lt;/summary&gt;
		@if (column.IsPrimaryKey) {
		[PrimaryKey]
		@}
		public ${column.TypeName} ${column.Name} { get; set; }
	@}
	}
}</pre>
</div>
<p>lua语言模板<code>entity_lua.tpl</code>：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>@{
	@lang lua
	local now = os.time();
}
// created at ${os.date('%Y-%m-%d', now)} by ${author}
using System;

namespace MyTest.Entity
{
	/// &lt;summary&gt;
	/// ${model.Memo}
	/// &lt;/summary&gt;
	[Table("${model.TableName}")]
	public class ${model.Name} {
	@for column in model.Columns do
		/// &lt;summary&gt;
		/// ${column.Memo}
		/// &lt;/summary&gt;
		@if column.IsPrimaryKey then
		[PrimaryKey]
		@end
		public ${column.TypeName} ${column.Name} { get; set; }
	@end
	}
}</pre>
</div>
<p>go语言模板<code>entity_go.tpl</code>&nbsp;：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>@{
	@lang go
	import 'time'
	var now = time.Now();
}
@*
golang中的时间格式：
2006 - yyyy
01 - MM
02 - dd
*@
// created at ${now.Format('2006-01-02')} by ${author}
using System;

namespace MyTest.Entity
{
	/// &lt;summary&gt;
	/// ${model.Memo}
	/// &lt;/summary&gt;
	[Table("${model.TableName}")]
	public class ${model.Name} {
	@* golang使用range遍历列表，第1个参数为下标，第2个参数为元素 *@
	@for _,column := range model.Columns {
		/// &lt;summary&gt;
		/// ${column.Memo}
		/// &lt;/summary&gt;
		@if column.IsPrimaryKey {
		[PrimaryKey]
		@}
		public ${column.TypeName} ${column.Name} { get; set; }
	@}
	}
}</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2107989898271668019_20" data-into-catalog-status="">6.2 渲染模板</h3>
<p data-pid="wS963XhL">nuget安装语言包</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>install-package AScript.Lang.JavaScript
install-package AScript.Lang.Go
install-package AScript.Lang.Lua</pre>
</div>
<p>定义模型类型</p>

<h2 id="h_2107989898271668019_21" data-into-catalog-status="">七、结束语</h2>
<p data-pid="Ifc7YEqj">AScript.Template模板引擎简单易用，功能全面，非常适合复杂模板场景，比如：html模板、邮件模板、打印模板、代码模板等。</p>
<p data-pid="Ifc7YEqj">大家在项目中用过哪些模板引擎呢？不防试试AScript模板引擎，欢迎交流和建议。</p>
<p data-pid="OKZyVMYp">开源地址：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="seY1kSzj">gitee：<a class=" external" title="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" data-draft-type="text-link" data-za-detail-view-id="1043" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="invisible">https://<span class="visible">gitee.com/rockey627/ASc<span class="invisible">ript</span></span></span></a></li>
<li data-pid="S7n2y64h">github：<a class=" external" title="https://github.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://github.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" data-draft-type="text-link" data-za-detail-view-id="1043" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="invisible">https://<span class="visible">github.com/rockey627/AS<span class="invisible">cript</span></span></span></a></li>
</ul>
<p data-pid="uOFVTBPE">QQ交流群：1124393316</p>
</div>
